text:
Maria Ops: Scheduling Dedicated rollout for customer New Horizon Health. Proposed window: Tue 2026-05-12 02:00-03:00 UTC (shiftable). Target slice: ded-4 (private VPC). Model pinned: v2.3.1-quant. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then full. KMS rotation currently planned at 01:30 UTC — we can move it if needed. Rollback plan: instant traffic cut to previous slice + revert to v2.3.0, metrics thresholds: error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase >200ms. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/nh-health-2.3.1

DeployBot: [automated] Rollout draft created -> rollout_id=rl-20260512-nh-01, dry-run started. CI checks: unit tests OK, infra lint OK, canary smoke tests: queued.

Jun SRE: ack. I'll be oncall that window and can watch the canary dashboards. Please tag me at start.

Kevin SRE: Quick ask — can we avoid KMS rotation during the canary? If rotation at 01:30 collides with wakeup traffic for backup jobs we saw last month, better to move to after ramp. Suggest move to 03:15 UTC.

Priya PM: Keisha / CS — customer preference on window? They asked for low-impact overnight, but their internal ops prefers after 02:30 UTC local.

Keisha CS: Confirmed with customer. They prefer start no earlier than 02:30 UTC. Also asked for a short post-rollout sync (15m) to validate telemetry. They will have an engineer available.

Maria Ops: OK shifting start to 02:30-03:30 UTC. Updating rollout window and KMS rotation to 03:15 UTC. Will update rollout_id metadata.

Ryan Release: Leaving a note — make sure the deployment manifest pins the exact docker image digest and model checkpoint id. We had drift last quarter. Also attach a one-line blurb for customer-facing release notes.

Maria Ops: Done — manifest pinned in repo: services/dedicated/rollouts/rl-20260512-nh-01.yaml

DeployBot: [automated] dry-run -> smoke tests passed. Canary smoke report: all endpoints healthy, sample outputs within baseline. Deployment manifest checksum: sha256:8b7f...c1a

Kevin SRE: Thanks. I still want a holdback plan ready in case we see cascading errors. Suggest pre-created terraform rollback to reroute traffic and an ops playbook snippet in the thread. I'll paste playbook at start of window.

Jun SRE: Add me to the pager escalation step. If error rate >0.5% and rollback is triggered, I'll coordinate with infra to flip traffic and run DB failover checklist.

Priya PM: Who needs to approve to proceed? I have product sign-off. We need SRE + CS + Security approval.

Maria Ops: Requesting approvals: @Jun SRE, @Kevin SRE, @Keisha CS, @SecurityOps (if present)

Kevin SRE: Approved from SRE side. :white_check_mark:

Jun SRE: Approved. I'll be active on the channel during the window. :eyes:

Keisha CS: CS approved and customer notified. Will join post-rollout sync.

Ryan Release: LGTY from release engineering. Please capture the final image digests in the release notes.

Maria Ops: Great — rolling window confirmed 02:30-03:30 UTC, KMS rotation 03:15 UTC, rollout_id=rl-20260512-nh-01. Pinning model v2.3.1-quant and docker digest recorded. DeployBot will trigger the canary at 02:30 UTC.

DeployBot: [automated] final schedule set -> rollout_id=rl-20260512-nh-01, scheduled_start=2026-05-12T02:30:00Z, canary_policy={5%:15m,25%:10m,100%:after}. Audit tags: customer=new-horizon-health, env=dedicated, private_vpc=true

Priya PM: One last ask — include a note in the postmortem template to check quality regression on hallucination rate for the model. We'll attach a small evaluation set.

Maria Ops: Added eval set link and post-rollout checklist: https://redwood.internal/ops/playbooks/rollouts/rl-20260512-nh-01-checklist

Keisha CS: :thumbsup: all good from my side. See you on the channel at 02:20 UTC for preflight.

Jun SRE: I'll post the quick rollback command at 02:25 UTC and kick off the rollback runbook if we hit thresholds.

Maria Ops: Thanks everyone — marking thread as ready. If anyone sees anything else, reply here.
